using CUDA, JSON3
import JACC
JACC.@init_backend
function heavy!(i, x, reps)
    v = x[i]
    for _ in 1:reps
        v = sin(v) + 0.5 * cos(v)
    end
    x[i] = v
    return nothing
end
# the shape of a generated host function: async launches, optional throw before the exit wait
function run_async!(x, n, reps, k, boom, drain)
    try
        for _ in 1:k
            JACC.@parallel_for range = n sync = false heavy!(x, reps)
        end
        boom && error("boom after the launches")
    finally
        drain && JACC.synchronize()
    end
    JACC.synchronize()
    return nothing
end
function trial(n, reps, k, drain, reader)
    x0 = rand(n)
    xref = JACC.array(copy(x0)); run_async!(xref, n, reps, k, false, false); ref = Array(xref)
    x = JACC.array(copy(x0))
    JACC.synchronize()
    t0 = time()
    caught = false
    try run_async!(x, n, reps, k, true, drain) catch e; caught = true end
    t_catch = time() - t0
    got = reader == :same ? Array(x) : fetch(Threads.@spawn Array(x))
    t_read = time() - t0
    return (caught = caught, t_catch_ms = round(1000t_catch; digits = 1), t_read_ms = round(1000t_read; digits = 1), equal = got == ref)
end
out = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    n = 2^20
    x = JACC.array(rand(n)); run_async!(x, n, 50, 1, false, false)
    reps = 500; t = @elapsed run_async!(x, n, reps, 1, false, false)
    reps = clamp(round(Int, reps * 0.03 / max(t, 1e-4)), 50, 200000)
    k = 20
    t1 = @elapsed run_async!(x, n, reps, 1, false, false)
    out["reps"] = reps; out["one_launch_ms"] = round(1000t1; digits = 1); out["launches"] = k
    out["nthreads"] = Threads.nthreads()
    out["on_device"] = string(typeof(x))
    for (nm, drain, reader) in (("undrained_same_task", false, :same), ("undrained_other_task", false, :other), ("drained_same_task", true, :same), ("drained_other_task", true, :other))
        out[nm] = [trial(n, reps, k, drain, reader) for _ in 1:5]
    end
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 3000)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
